name: Hono Skill
headline: Hono Skill - Develop Hono Applications
short_description: Develop Hono applications efficiently using the Hono CLI. Ideal for operations teams building web services, APIs, and serverless functions. Integrates with existing workflows and connects to cloud platforms.
author: yusukebe

sections.overview:
Hono Skill is an agent skill that enables developers to build Hono web applications efficiently with integrated API reference and request testing capabilities. It provides inline knowledge of Hono's core features including routing, context, middleware, JSX, validation, RPC, streaming, and helper functions. The skill uses the Hono CLI to test requests directly within your development environment. It supports Claude Code and skills.sh installation methods and optionally integrates with the hono-docs MCP server for real-time documentation search and retrieval. This skill helps developers accelerate web service and API development by combining language model assistance with practical testing tools.
Building REST APIs with Hono routing and middleware
Creating serverless functions with Hono context and helpers
Testing API requests during development without leaving your IDE
Implementing request validation and streaming responses
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/yusukebe/hono-skill`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
